mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.name, m.code, m.type, m.parent_id AS parentId, m.path, m.redirect, m.icon, m.component, m.layout, m.keep_alive AS keepAlive, m.method, m.description, m.show, m.status, m.`order`, m.del_flag AS delFlag, m.create_time AS createTime, m.update_time AS updateTime FROM menu m INNER JOIN role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.status = '1' AND m.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.`order` ASC, m.id ASC
